body.text: GBA is a hub of medical equipment manufacturing not only in China but globally in the perspectives of market ownership. By the end of 2021, Guangdong has 4,457 medical equipment manufactures and 23 of which went to public market. The revenue of latter ones was £15 billion, which took 32.8% account of national market. Both numbers were the leading figures over rest of provinces.
